title: Harmonized quarterly roadmap: hosted API & model catalog governance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Quarterly planning initiative to unify Hosted API roadmap items with the model catalog lifecycle. Goals: 1) Define a single source of truth for model availability, deprecation, and compatibility; 2) Establish canary & rollout guardrails tied to performance and cost OKRs; 3) Create a cross-team cadence (PM/Eng/Design/Research) for release gating and post-deploy evaluation. This ticket captures scope, success metrics, dependencies, and an initial timeline for Q3 planning and operational handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical model catalog schema and status states (stable, experimental, deprecated) documented and approved
Rollout playbook with canary thresholds (latency P50/P95, regression tolerance, cost per token) reviewed by Eng and SRE
Cross-functional calendar with quarterly gating reviews and owners assigned
Automation tasks for catalog propagation to Hosted API and Dedicated routing completed as PRs or RFCs
Two pilot model rollouts coordinated with telemetry dashboards and alert rules
comments: 2026-03-02 - PM kickoff: synced with Eng (Nadia), Research (Ravi), Design (Maya). Agreed on canonical lifecycle states and need for deprecation lead time (default 90 days).
2026-03-04 - Eng feedback: runtime team prefers deprecation hooks emitted from catalog to trigger KV cache invalidation; added as dependency ENG-4128.
2026-03-05 - Design feedback: UX needs a model-status badge and a timeline view in Console; created DES-441 for mockups.
2026-03-07 - Decision: Use stable/preview/experimental/deprecated states. Preview models require a canary policy and opt-in route. Action: draft canary thresholds and automation steps.

2026-03-09 - Research note: Evaluation harness will include latency, generation quality (ROUGE/BERTEval), and hallucination regression checks for top-20 prompts. Link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ML/Model+Eval+Harness
2026-03-10 - Security: KMS rotation impact considered; private deployments need mirror propagation plan. Security review required for private catalog sync (security_review_required=true).
2026-03-12 - Next steps: draft rollout playbook, schedule cross-team gating meeting for 2026-03-18, and open RFC for catalog schema (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/187).
notes: Trade-offs considered: aggressive model pruning reduces catalog surface area (cost benefit) but increases risk of customer regressions; proposed mitigation: expanded preview window and curated fallback variants.
Canary policy draft: 1% traffic for 48h, monitor P95 latency (+/- 10% threshold), quality regression < 2% on sentinel prompts, cost per token delta <= 15% compared to baseline.
Telemetry: add a per-model dashboard tile showing cost/latency/quality trends; link to dashboard template: https://dash.redwood.com/d/hostedapi/model-overview
Rollout phases: plan -> preview (internal) -> preview (select customers) -> full launch. Each phase requires sign-off from PM, Eng lead, and SRE on metrics.
Governance: quarterly catalog audit led by PM and Research to identify models for promotion/retirement; retention of audit notes in Confluence.
